title: Unit Event — Burn My Soul

meta.Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD and Ken burn the candle at both ends figuring out how they'll surpass RAD WEEKEND. Tasked with reigniting fervor in the residents of Vivid Street, Akito tries to burn brighter than ever before, but will it go up in smoke?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Huh? Sorry, I didn't mean to space out... What's up?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro's Friend
rows.Line: Our event. How many times are you gonna make us ask you? You wanna be in it...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro's Friend
rows.Line: You haven't done a single one since that day, right...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro's Friend
rows.Line: You're such a good singer, but you haven't been performing... It seems like a waste, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry...
I really appreciate you inviting me...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro's Friend
rows.Line:
No, don't apologize!
Just let us know if things change, okay?
You'll always be welcome.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro's Friend
rows.Line: Anyway, we gotta start getting ready for it. Catch you later!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: (It has been a while since that day...)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
(I wonder what the others are doing...
I heard that Ken's closing his shop temporarily...)

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: Hey, when do you think Weekend Garage is gonna open back up?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Yeah...
The curry there's so good. I wanna have it again.

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
It can't stay closed forever.
I mean, everyone around here gathered there. Where do you think Ken's gone?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Dunno...
And he's not the only one who's mysteriously disappeared.

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: I haven't seen Vivid BAD SQUAD anywhere recently. What do you think they're up to right now?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Wait, you haven't heard?
Apparently, Vivid BAD SQUAD broke up.

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: They quit singing after Taiga gave them that clobbering.

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: I mean, this is Taiga we're talking about here. No one's gonna come out in one piece after going toe-to-toe with that guy.

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Really?
I heard a rumor that they'd gone somewhere else.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: There's no way they'd quit so easily...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Oh, sir...!
I-It's been a while!

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
Yeah, long time no see.
Not since that event.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right!
Also, you remembered my name...?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
Of course I did.
The event you and your friends put on was really something.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
I heard about your battle against Taiga.
He didn't pull any punches, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: But you haven't upped and packed your bags. You're tougher than I thought.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Since that day, I haven't been hanging around here as much. I'm only here today because my friends basically forced me to. They said, “Quit beating yourself up and come join us.”

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Regardless of the reason, I'm glad you've decided to come back.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Especially considering how no one seems to have seen Arata, EVER or Vivid BAD SQUAD lately.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
I dunno if this is true...
But I just heard a rumor that Vivid BAD SQUAD broke up. Is that possible?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: No, I'm pretty sure they're still at it...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: A few months ago, I decided to head over to Ken's place with some old friends. Because... I wanted to talk to An.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
I only got to speak to her for a little bit...
But that can wait for now.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
Based on what I saw, they're still singing and doing what they've always done.
However...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
They appear to have gone to another area.
It could be that they've decided to base themselves elsewhere...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Mita, have you not been speaking with them...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wait.
There's something we need to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
Still, this town feels so empty now...
Like a venue after a crowd's left.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: I wish you'd all come back and stir things up again...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
(He's right...
It hasn't been that long, but things have really changed around here.)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
(There used to be more excitement.
Everyone was singing on the street and giving this place such a unique flavor.)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: (Did they really give up on surpassing RAD WEEKEND and head somewhere else? No, that can't be right.)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: (Because they were the ones telling me to do the opposite. To not give up...)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: (I wouldn't be surprised if they have given up...)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: (Stop, there's no point in thinking about stuff like that..)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: (It's none of my business now anyway.)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
(I hung up my hat before them.
I ran without listening to what they had to say. I have no right to say anything.)

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: Hey, isn't that Shinonome from Vivid BAD SQUAD...? I didn't know he was still around.

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: But why's he all by himself?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: Then, the rumors about them breaking up after losing to Taiga were true?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Since that day, everyone around here's lost all confidence in us.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (This just means it'll feel that much better when we get them going.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Now, let's start discussing your plans moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: In other words, how you're actually going to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So, to get right to it...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: What do you all think you need to achieve in order to be able to say, “We surpassed RAD WEEKEND”?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What do we need to achieve...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think we can say that if we figure out a way to achieve a more electric atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I still have no idea how we're actually going to pull that off.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right...
I was under the impression that we'd be able to once we became good enough... But now that we know why RAD WEEKEND happened...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: However, I know of just one way for you to all surpass that event and achieve a more electric atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Nagi's wishes, the path that we took as RADder, the feelings we created in all the locals...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You need to overwrite those feelings with something completely new.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do you mean when you say that...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Remember what you said that day when you found out the truth?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You said you were going to surpass RAD WEEKEND and show us—RADder—what things look like from on top of the world.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You have to take those feelings and turn them into music—into an event—for everyone to see.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Everyone carries different dreams, different feelings...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Nagi wanted you, the next generation, to go beyond our dream, and I want to be there to see what that looks like.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: All our old friends around town wanted to see her wish fulfilled.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Your audience and the young blood around town have gone cold on you, but I'm certain that on some level, they still want to see someone like you guys surpass that legendary night.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: It may just be their subjective ideas...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
But when that comes true...
When everyone sees that you're going to go further than we could...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: That's when you'll have created the kind of energy that surpasses RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean... I believe that, and I really want it to happen.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But the problem is, we don't have what it takes to make that happen right now...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's not just skill. We lost our friends, and everyone around here has lost interest in us. And we couldn't have beaten him even if there were a hundred of us.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I understand that the road up ahead is going to be rough...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: But I believe in all of you.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I'll be the first one to tell you all that I want you to go beyond our dream.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
No, the second...
She was the first.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Everyone around here wants that to happen. If you can remind them of that hope and give them something to place it in again, then you'll start making inroads.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If we don't do something, nothing's going to change!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Otherwise, we'll never be able to surpass RAD WEEKEND. It's our turn to act.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right...! I promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Now then...
Let's start getting into some of the details.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: From what I understand, your next move involves two things.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
One is simple. Get better.
You'll have no hope of succeeding if you don't.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: The other is to do what I said a second ago. Show everyone around here some new feelings to overwrite the past.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
First, you all need to get better.
And competing against real opponents will force you to do that.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So, I'll start taking you to some high-level venues where only the best of the best gather. Your job is to battle against them in events.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Where the best of the best gather...?
Places like Crawl Green?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Exactly.
They won't even let you in the door if you're just “good”.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They even won't let us in...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I'll be asking you to do this basically every day while practicing like normal. After school during the week, I'll come pick you up in the car and drive you straight to these live houses.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Drive us...?
Are these places far?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Yes, they are.
You'll find all sorts of unbelievable performers outside of Vivid Street.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Just like RADder, each city has its own homegrown talent that's fought its way to the top.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
You'll be going up against them.
Fortunately, I know someone.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(I see...
We're gonna battle against the best that these places have to offer, teams just like RADder...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We've each been doing what we need to while Ken's been driving us to live houses...every single day.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And we've definitely improved after battling against so many tough opponents. Still...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Even if you do get better, just putting on events like you've been doing until now probably won't get you far.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: It's hard to make a flame burn bright when it's close to going out. You won't get many chances.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Which is why... You're going to split up the work.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: These will be crucial steps towards putting on an event that surpasses RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: First, Akito, you go reignite your audience.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
I'm sure you already know...
But after your battle against Taiga, people have mostly lost the hope they held for you.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Getting them to feel it again is going to be the furthest thing from easy.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Which is why this is going to be your job.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Even in the most dire of situations, you don't bend or break. You're here right now because you kept fighting and never gave up.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
They were witnesses to that...
They watched you like they were watching RADder.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: If you manage to get back on your feet despite all that's happened... No, not just that, but become unbelievably skilled, then you'll reignite your audience.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hold on. Why just Akito?
Shouldn't we do that together? I mean...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
It's like Ken said.
We aren't gonna get many chances to reestablish ourselves in this town.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, we need to hold off on performing together until we're fully ready. We have to wait for the opportune moment...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right now, everyone probably thinks that we've all turned tail and ran.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just becoming a little better isn't going to convince them that we're still serious.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But if I manage to put on an event on my own that's as good as the ones we did together, then they'll consider giving us another chance.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Does that sound about right, Ken...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In other words, they'll start thinking, “If Akito alone can do this, what will happen when all four of them get back together?”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Akito, go knock their socks off!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Akito.
In order to accomplish this, you'll need to become unbelievably good.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, I hope you're ready...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: As for you three, I'd like to talk to each of you individually. Starting with...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Right now, I don't have what it takes to reignite their excitement...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (That means I have to get better. A lot better.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, you two, the car's here!
This way!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Sorry I'm late.
We got stuck in traffic after I went to pick Kohane up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No, that's not a problem.
We actually just got here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, Ken, where are we going today?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
A place called “Rodin”.
It's somewhere that gave even my team a lot of trouble.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's a pretty high-level venue.
Only a few places in Japan can really match it.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You'll find top-level performers who want to put their skills to the test and even pros signed to major labels there.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In other words, the audience will have high expectations...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
They will.
You don't stand a chance there yet.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: But what you all need right now are opponents who are ridiculously better than you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Some of the places we've been performing at have been pretty tough. But I guess we're in for something else today.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(But that's what we want...
The bigger the wall, the better we have to get to overcome it.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We're gonna figure out a way no matter what...!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Looks like it.
They're pretty good for their age...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(We're singing with everything we have...
But they don't care at all...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But we can't let things end this way...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We need to get them going...! We need to win...!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
What are they called again?
Vivid BAD SQUAD...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (Akito's grown quite a lot throughout this process. However...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: It feels like he's wearing shackles for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But they were saying how one of their regular teams wasn't here today. I'm not sure we would've fared as well if they were present...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry, mind if I lie down for a bit? I feel totally drained...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
M-Me too...
But is it okay for us to?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
A few minutes should be fine.
We've already gone around to say thank you to everyone, and it's going to take Ken a little bit to fetch the car.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay...
Then, just for a bit...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It only took them a few seconds to fall asleep...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your eyes are having trouble staying open. You haven't been sleeping much lately because of your thing, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Rest your eyes for a bit.
I'll let you know when Ken gets here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay...
Just for a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Looks like we're all feeling pretty fatigued...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(But I guess we should be.
Between training and the jobs we've each been given, we've been stretching ourselves thin every day.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We managed to pull out a win today...)

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Oh, hey.
Isn't that Vivid BAD SQUAD...?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: Didn't Taiga totally demolish them the other day?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: Yeah, everyone's been talking about that battle. Winning in style's one thing, but that was pretty mean of him...

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: I really thought they had a chance against him. Guess this means no one's ever gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We won't make it at this rate.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We've gotta keep getting better and figure out a way to ignite everyone again.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Hey, sorry about the wait.
Oh, did the others fall asleep...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry.
I'll wake them up and—

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
We still have some time before this place closes.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I'm sure you're also pretty exhausted, Akito. Why don't you get some rest?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No, I'm okay...
I still have plenty left in the tank.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Not bad...
We've definitely gotten better after going up against so many tough opponents.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: It still doesn't feel like enough?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You really need to relax more, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
You've become so much better.
All your hard work is already paying off.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: But you're trying to fly higher and higher... Which is holding you back from your true potential. You're hitting a ceiling that you put there yourself.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So, stop for a second to take a deep breath and relax... Just sing from your heart.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I know what he means about me needing to relax more. That's always been a bad habit of mine.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(But, singing from my heart...?
I don't think he's talking about putting more feeling into my singing...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I'm talking about you working with me one-on-one. We'll have to find the time in the morning and evenings before and after your training sessions, but what do you say...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, Ken, you and me? One-on-one...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...!
Yes, please!
I'd be more than happy to!!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Hey, not so loud.
You'll wake An and the others.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(No way...
Ken's going to work with me one-on-one...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He's one of the reasons I have this dream... He's my hero.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And now he's offering to help me improve by working with me one-on-one.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (There's no way I was gonna refuse...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to working with you, Ken!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Nice work today, Aoyagi.
I'm sure you're tired. How are you feeling...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Good. I feel much better after taking that nap in the green room before we came back.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, the thing I've been working on has been taking up quite a bit of my time. I'm still only about thirty percent finished...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's pretty good, all things considered.
I'm still trying to figure out how to do it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too. I've been practicing...but I really don't know if what I'm doing is okay.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: At the same time, I guess there's no easy answer... I'm hoping to figure things out while taking it one step at a time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, also... Don't you guys all have to start heading home soon?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You're right.
I'll go get Akito, and—

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, wait...
He's practicing with Ken starting today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I still can't believe they made that arrangement while we were sleeping.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Still...
That explains why Dad's been singing lately.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Recently, while we're at school, he's apparently been singing. My guess is that he's trying to sort of get back his old groove...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
His old groove...?
I'd love to hear him sing sometime.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Again, thank you for agreeing to do this...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Proactive as ever.
I honestly wasn't expecting you to ask to start practicing together today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I felt that the sooner the better.
I apologize if I'm asking too much of you...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Now, Akito, remember what I told you when we were at Rodin...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I do.
I need to relax...and sing from my heart more, right?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Right.
Of course, trying to relax doesn't mean you get to start cutting corners. You still have to sing with everything you have.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Anyway, how we're going to practice is fairly simple. We'll take turns singing.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Alright.
Hit me with your best shot.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(I'm used to being around Ken...
But now, facing him like this, he seems larger than life.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Even so, I'm not about to back down.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(He personally agreed to work with me.
I need to make the most of this opportunity...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Yes...!
My voice sounds better than it did during today's event.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Not bad.
But you're still tense...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Don't apologize.
We're here for that very reason.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (In the old days, my jaw would've hit the floor and that would've been it.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(But things are different now...
I can sing now, so I know what to look for.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Ken doesn't sing with the sort of overwhelming power that Taiga does.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(He's cool and calm.
His breath control is incredible.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It must've taken so much effort to learn how to do this.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm guessing he practiced like there was no tomorrow day after day until he got ahold of this ability. At least, that's what it feels like...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (This intense excitement welling up inside of me.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(He's cool as ice, but giving off this blistering hot energy...!
Just like...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Akito.
What crossed your mind when you were watching me just now?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
I'm guessing a lot of things.
Like what you saw all those years ago.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I bet you look at me and see that night. RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Just think about that and nothing else, and sing.
Throw everything you have at it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Calm down...
Just do as Ken says... Don't think about anything else.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(First, digest his words.
Relax, sing from your heart.
Throw everything you have at RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Let's stop here for today.
You seem to be at your limit.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: For now, go home, rest and get ready for tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Grr... No.
I just don't get it.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Nothing's changing no matter how much I sing... And Ken's expression hasn't changed once.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (How many hours have we been practicing...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (My brain's not getting enough oxygen because of all this singing...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Let's stop here for today...
You're at your limit.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Even though Ken's working with me one-on-one, I can't produce any results...still...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (I've been trying every trick I know, but those shackles won't come off easily...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
(I guess that's only natural...
After all, this is what brought Akito this far.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Why don't we go for a drive?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Let's make a pit stop here.
Want something to drink?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Well, I accepted Ken's invitation, and now we're here...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (So, he actually just felt like going for a drive...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Or was he trying to give me a breath of fresh air because I was having trouble focusing?)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Here, have a cafe au lait.
It's hot, so be careful.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (How long has it been since the last time I just sat and did nothing like this?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Lately, I've been practicing as soon as I wake up, then going to school, a live house after that and singing with Ken at the end... There's been no time in that schedule for me to relax...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Is it okay for me to be doing this right now?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Wouldn't it be better for me to use this time to practice instead...?)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: This reminds me of the first time I met you.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Do you remember?
The first time we spoke to each other on Vivid Street.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Huh? You're from RADder... What are you...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Here, drink this.
Mind if I sit next to you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You remember how we met, Ken?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Yeah, like it happened yesterday.
The way you looked like you were about to start sobbing is hard to forget.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, you should definitely forget about that...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You've changed so much since then.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You came this far by following your heart. I couldn't be more impressed.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
So, tell me.
What was it like sprinting at full speed until now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So much has happened. I'm not sure how to put it into words...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Ow...!
Wh-Why'd you flick my forehead...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So that you don't forget how you felt just now.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Akito. Next time, sing with that feeling in mind.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
You already have everything you need.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: All you have to do now is realize that and sing.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Oh, it's getting late.
We should start heading back.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You're sure you don't want me to take you further than the station?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yes, since the trains are still running.
Thank you for working with me this late.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
No problem.
Just make sure to get some rest. See you later.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
You already have everything you need.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: All you have to do now is realize that and sing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I just need to realize it, huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Based on what Ken said, it feels like the answer should be right in front of me.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm one step away from finding that thing I've been missing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I have all of you to thank...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Miku, you guys...
Shinonome, Aoyagi, An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I am who I am now because of all of you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I don't have to worry about everything on my own.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Welcome!
Were you guys practicing again today?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Then, please take a seat.
I'm sure you're tired, so let me get you something to drink.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
MEIKO told me everything!
You've all been going around to different live houses to perform at them, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That sounds like so much fun.
I'd love to see the live houses in your world.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Luka, remember what I told you the other day? You shouldn't interrupt them needlessly.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, what has training at these live houses involved? You must have been singing with some really good performers.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They're on a completely different level compared to us. We have to do everything we can just to keep up with them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We have a planning meeting during the drive over after school, sing at the live house, do a debrief on our way home, then do it all over again...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Fortunately, we've somehow been managing to hold our ground...
...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: With that in mind, can I ask you guys something?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, Akito, you've been practicing with An's dad...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
For a few weeks now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I'm having a lot of trouble making any progress...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I understand what Ken's telling me to do, but I can't figure out how to put that into practice.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, based on what you just told us, that does seem very tricky...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Relax and sing from your heart.
Turn your feelings into song.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That's easier said than done.
In terms of actually accomplishing those things...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hmmm... That's a tough one.
This is all about intuition...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Akito.
Would you mind singing something for us?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes!
I think hearing you actually sing will make it easier for us to give you proper advice.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
She has a point.
I think we'd all like to hear you sing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Okay, then...
If you all don't mind listening...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (A lot of time's passed since I last sang here because I've been practicing in our world so much...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But this is my chance to hear from Luka and the others about my singing.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (This might lead me to the answer...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Take your feelings...and turn them into song...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That was incredible.
I think I've got goosebumps...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah...! You sent shivers down my spine!
You've gotten so much better, Akito!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, I have been practicing basically nonstop.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But tell me more.
What else did you guys notice?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You sounded really amazing just now, Akito...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I feel like you can do a lot more! Like, pow!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know what you're trying to say, but you need to be more specific with your advice...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I mean, Akito, I'm guessing that you're feeling a lot of different things right now...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're happy about getting to practice with Ken. You're excited, and you want to make him proud, but you're nervous at the same time...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You should just let that all out. Pow!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In other words, I'm not letting my feelings flow freely...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
There's that...
But... How do I put it...? Oh.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why don't we do what you and Ken have been doing? Let's sing together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You and me singing together, Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: To get you to let your feelings out all at once, of course!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're talking about singing from my heart like Ken said, right? But just singing together doesn't seem like...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Fine, then let's make it a battle!
That should be more enticing, no?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're not going to run, are you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I know what you're doing, and I'd really rather not take the bait...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Just based on her instinct, Luka seems to know what it is that I'm missing.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yay! Thank you, Akito!
This'll help me a lot since I'm much better at getting things across with song!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You did have to twist his arm quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That's just how I do things!
Oh, would you all mind acting as the judges?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, sure!
I'll be a judge!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Thank you! Then, let's get started!
Who should go first? Me...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Alright, I'm going to hit the ground running!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Luka really is an incredible singer...
She's going strong right out the gates.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (This song... I've heard it before somewhere...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Oh, right...
This is the one I sang with Toya and the others when we went camping.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Why does she seem so happy...?
But her smile's kinda infectious.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay, that seems like a nice way to start! Now, Akito, it's your turn!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The way Luka sang just now was really good.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But what was she trying to tell me...?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, not bad!
In that case, let's see how you do when we speed things up!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? She sounds totally different now!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Yeah...! It's the one I sang when I confronted those guys from Shepard!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I managed to break through the ceiling I had felt trapped under before. But I wasn't satisfied with just that...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (After that, people started telling me that I reminded them of Taiga or Ken... That gave me a bit of confidence.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(However, Len's right...
She sounds completely different now. Almost like some kind of illusion...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(No, wait... There's more to this...
I feel something welling up inside of me.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Tell me what you're feeling! Give me everything you have!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes!
You've felt and experienced a lot of different emotions up until now. So, let's throw everything we have at each other!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: MEIKO! Is it just me, or did Akito sound a little different just now...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, just a little bit, but...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think Luka's trying to draw out Akito's feelings in order to free them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Whenever Akito sings, he gives off this impression of wanting to get better—to “surpass”.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
And there's nothing wrong with that.
His unyielding work ethic is the reason why he's been able to grow to this point.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But there may be a myriad of other emotions hiding behind all that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Giving up fun things to focus on improving. Burying any worries or sadness that cropped up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, to some degree you need that self-control to keep moving forward. But Akito's done enough of that already.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now, he needs to take the next step.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He needs to dig deep and rediscover those feelings that have been buried away for so long. He needs to free them and turn them into song.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's what Luka's trying to teach him. She's trying to make him realize.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I have a feeling that Ken's been thinking the same thing while singing with Akito...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, he has a special place in Akito's heart. He can't help but tense up in his presence.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I can feel all these emotions rising to the surface...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
You already have everything you need.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If I can turn these feelings into song, then...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wait, Luka, what's wrong...?!
Akito was just about to...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I know what was about to happen...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But you need to save that for when you sing against Ken.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right now, Akito, there are a lot of different emotions swirling around inside of you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But you shouldn't be unleashing them on me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You need to do that to your hero. You need to do that to Ken!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I really appreciate it, Luka.
I have a much better idea of what I need to do now thanks to you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Now, go unleash everything you just felt! Pow!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
(He seems much calmer today...
I'm not sensing any of his usual anxiety today.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I take it you figured something out...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
In that case, I'll start us off today.
Ready?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
(I see...
He's focusing on the way I'm singing.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (Then, I'll need to put on a good performance for him...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Hearing Ken sing just fills me up with so much excitement. I can feel the pulse in my fingers.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(On top of that, lately...
He's been singing just for me.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (This has to be some kind of miracle...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Feel his song. Let it flow through you...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Listen to the man who ignited an eternal flame in you.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (You got the blood pumping in my heart. You. No one else.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's because of you that I'm stood here right now.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Nervousness, excitement, happiness... All these emotions I should have felt being around you. I should never have suppressed them like I did.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Which is why I'm going to feel them all now, completely. Everything you gave me.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm gonna turn that into my strength and surpass you!!)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (You have a habit of overthinking things. That's why you need to make things more simple for yourself.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (Happiness, sadness, anger... Everything you've felt... That all needs to become your fuel.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He sang like this at RAD WEEKEND...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(No...
What am I doing...? I thought I was ready for this.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Am I really going to be able to...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Burn everything that you have inside of you!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (You gave me so much when I saw you at RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Things were really hard at first, and I felt like giving up more times than I wanna admit.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (They decided to stand by my side.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(And...
Even after gaining and losing so much...
Even after being beaten to a pulp like this, I can keep going...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Because I'm never going to forget that night!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The flame you lit inside of me that night is still burning strong.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And I can't thank you enough for that.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(That's right...
Take everything away, and this is what's left.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (That desire. The one that brought me this far.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(I'm gonna surpass you.
I'm gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND, and then I'll go even further!!!)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I want to witness the moment you and your team surpass us.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Alright, you've all put in plenty of effort until today.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
You've all reached a good level.
I say the time is ripe.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
It's time for you to lead the charge.
Are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yes.
I'm ready to go whenever.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You know, a part of me still wants us all to sing together since this is our big return...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I know you're gonna really ignite everyone, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Me too...!
I know you can do it, Shinonome!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Your hard work will pay off...
I firmly believe that.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Give it everything you've got.
We'll be watching from across the street so that we don't get in your way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I know that rumors have been spreading about us while we've been gone.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Some of you thought that Vivid BAD SQUAD broke up after losing to Taiga. That we ran away with our tails between our legs. But...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And I'm here today to show you that we're serious!!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: They haven't given up! Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(But it feels kinda weird.
I mean, I'm carrying a huge responsibility, and I can't screw this up, and still...)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: How much did he practice to get to this level...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: He got this good while we weren't looking...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: (He was like that from the start.)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: (Everyone used to make fun of him for only having a loud voice and nothing else. Including me.)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
(We didn't think he was special.
Just another talentless, average Joe.)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: (But he works harder than anyone I know, and he's long since surpassed all his naysayers.)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: (I mean, now I think about it, I had come to really like the way he sang)

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: We might be witnessing history in the making here...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
(I already know the answer to that...
No matter how hard I work, I'm still terrible because I don't have any guts...)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
(And I ran.
I didn't keep singing until the end like him...)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: (I...want to learn to sing like him...)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
(I...don't wanna give up.
I might be awful now, but if I keep trying... Maybe someday...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Now do you guys see? We're not kidding around.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Imagine what's gonna happen when all four of us are here. You'll get to witness something even more incredible.

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: More incredible than what we just saw...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We're gonna have it at COL!
And it's gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: RAD WEEKEND isn't just some legendary event.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We know why it happened.
The emotions and hopes that went into it. We know the true story behind it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're going to take on those emotions and surpass it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You guys are gonna see that night... No.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're going to see a new legend!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you want to surpass that night, join us on this ride!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: (How can I go back after running away from the opportunity they gave me? I just can't...)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I don't want to be a burden to them anymore...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: So, this is it for you...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: (Am I just gonna keep running away...?)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: (I'm going to be a terrible singer and a coward that's full of regrets for the rest of my life...?)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
I'm done giving up...
I want to take a hard look at the way I sing like he has. And maybe, that'll let me...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Let me come with you!
Please! Gimme another chance...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I know I'm not in a position to be asking you this...! But please...! I'm begging you!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I... I want to learn to sing like you...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I want to surpass RAD WEEKEND with you and the others...!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wanting to sing like me or just sing with us isn't gonna be enough.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Are you ready to do whatever it takes to surpass that night? Do you have the guts?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I'm never running away! Not ever again!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I wanna surpass that night! With you guys!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously, it took you long enough...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You don't really need to thank me or anything.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You keep saying how you're so terrible, but that's not true. You know how to sing with passion.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We're gonna need you for this.
So, let's go surpass RAD WEEKEND together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We got one of our group back.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much for coming back.
We're looking forward to working with you again.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's do our best to surpass RAD WEEKEND together, Mita!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Thanks for having me back, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Come here. Take a look at everyone outside.

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: Are they really gonna do it during their next event...?!

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
But I thought COL closed down.
What do you think's going on?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: I dunno, but the way Shinonome sang just now... If he can do that by himself, then...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You've definitely succeeded in igniting them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But that wasn't the real thing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I'm gonna make this flame even bigger.
And, next time...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Right.
I'll be looking forward to that moment.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Thank you.
We promise not to disappoint.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Well, now that Akito's accomplished his goal...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's go out there and show everyone in this town that we mean business!!!
